criterion: Write H=VV^T with row vectors v_i in R^r and let Z be the zero off-diagonal positions. H is extreme iff the only R in Sym_r satisfying v_i^T R v_i=0 for every i and v_i^T R v_j=0 for every (i,j) in Z is R=0.
theorem: The optimizer set has affine dimension 66. The displayed linear criterion is necessary and sufficient for extremality. Every set partition of twelve labels yields one extreme block-correlation matrix, giving at least Bell(12)=4,213,597 distinct extreme points.
